note: Macklin Bay is one of the camping areas at Swanson Reservoir SRA, about 4.5 mi west of Trenton: a small electric loop on the slope north of the railroad, about 220 m from the Macklin Bay arm and 300 m from the main lake. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica (now booking Swanson, which the 2025 grid listed as walk-up only) confirms 50 A Electric Plus at Macklin Bay; 5 sites listed (004-009), reservable May 1 on and first-come otherwise; facility 'Open year round', so season changed false -> year_round. Water/sewer cleared (RA: 'Full Hookup - no', no water/sewer tag). Not waterfront stands (~220 m to the bay arm across the loop road, rail line between the loop and the lake). Pin 175 m south on the rail crossing; optional re-pin. Phone differs.
flags: PHONE: stored 308-276-2671 is not on any page read; ReserveAmerica 'Information: (308)334-5493' and the NGPC 2025 grid row 'Swanson Lake SRA ... 308-334-5493' agree. Suggest 308-334-5493 (also flagged on 2741 Spring Canyon). apply.py doesn't write phone.

FEES question (not changed; fees provenance is a 2026-10-12 human read): stored low $10 / high $15 + electric $15 is the statewide grid (primitive $10, basic $15, Electric Plus $30). ReserveAmerica lists only Electric Plus sites at Macklin Bay ($30.00 for 5/3/2027, site 004), and no page shows a basic or primitive site in this loop, so the base for this entry may be $30 rather than $10. The basic sites ReserveAmerica lists are in Spring Canyon (020, 021, $15.00 for 5/3/2027) and Lake View.

SITE COUNT not changed: stored 17 (2026-09 note prose). ReserveAmerica lists 5 Macklin Bay sites; on NAIP the loop holds roughly 10-17 pads, so the rest are presumably first-come. No page gives the loop total.

MAX LENGTH not written: every Swanson site on ReserveAmerica reads 'Driveway Length: 40 / Max Vehicle Length: 40', which looks like a park-wide default (2741's verifier read it the same way). It fits EKKO either way.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands (lead, no change): ReserveAmerica 'Near Water - no' on all five sites. On Esri/NAIP with the GIS points the loop (40.1739-40.1742, -101.0978 to -101.0992) sits on an open slope with the loop road around it; the Macklin Bay arm is ~220 m west past the shower building and park road, and the main lake ~300 m south beyond the BNSF rail line and a wooded/grassy slope. At most a distant view; nothing supports *view from the pads, so no change.
PIN: stored 40.17295,-101.09985 is on the rail-line crossing ~175 m south of the loop (under the 250 m line). Optional re-pin to the site centroid 40.17406,-101.09840.
SAND RULE passes: pads 'Driveway Surface: Gravel'. ReserveAmerica also carries a 'Beach Camping (Trail 3)-old' nonspecific basic unit at Swanson; it is not this loop.

LEAD (other Swanson areas): the DB has Macklin Bay (2742) and Spring Canyon (2741). ReserveAmerica's third loop, Lake View (8 grass Basic sites 045-052, 40.1505-40.1513, -101.0673 to -101.0697), sits ~400 m NE of Spring Canyon's north end and ~400 m W of 2741's pin, and is not in the DB by name; it may be meant as part of 2741. The beach/primitive camping on the south shore below Macklin Bay (loops by the shore visible on imagery at ~40.168,-101.096) is not in the DB and would be a sand-rule question if anyone proposed it.
